meta._note: What a family should check with the breeder before buying a puppy or kitten (vet feedback, David 2026-10-11). general.<species> = items for every breed; breeds.<id> = health tests of the parents. Levels: minimum = the Royal Kennel Club's 'strongly recommend that breeders, at a minimum, conduct these tests' (Good Practice) or a breeding-register requirement; best_practice = RKC Best Practice; other_scheme = an existing scheme from another A/B source that the basis page does not list. UK lists are an orientation — breeding rules in Slovenia are set per breed by the breed club under KZS (FCI Art. 19, K7). Quotes = what the fetch tool returned verbatim. Not vet-reviewed. Statuses: listed | none_recommended | not_found. general.<species>[].country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. SI) marks a national rule shown only to that country's readers; items without it apply everywhere.
